description: Soldiers in steel helmets and ponchos, one carrying a bolt-action rifle, file through a muddy sandbagged trench at night, lit by a hanging oil lantern. Behind them is a misty jungle valley with hills, a moon, a flare or fire, and a small clearing with low buildings and a strip of ground. The painting fills the image edge to edge, with no text, frame or gore.
reason: Shows infantry in a wartime trench, but the card is the SS Ideal X, a converted tanker carrying truck trailers on the first container-ship voyage. There is no ship, port, crane, trailer or cargo anywhere in the picture.
